title: 2030 — First workplace hulls networks graduate 100
definition: 2030 milestone on the Outcome-Only Workplaces roadmap.
description:
First workplace hulls networks graduate 100,000 learners with metric design credentials employers trust.

What must be true first: the outcome contracts results have to replicate outside the lab, workplace logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and metric design operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed outcome contracts demonstrations, workplace logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting metric design uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Outcome-Only Workplaces readiness from component maturity.

definition: Simulates Outcome-Only Workplaces operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where outcome contracts monitoring, workplace logistics redundancy, or metric design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Outcome-Only Workplaces Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Outcome-Only Workplaces: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Outcome-Only Workplaces — workplaces measuring only outcomes.

Phase 1 — Prove (outcome contracts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (workplace logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (metric design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (autonomy culture): workplace hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and companies-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
